content: Claude native chat sharing: (1) public link snapshot, no account needed to view; (2) share with specific people by email on ALL plans (Free included), invite bound to the invited email, free account required to view, view-only: recipients cannot continue the chat, copy it to their account, or download files; attached files are not in the snapshot; pending invites expire after 30 days; daily invitation limit; not available from the mobile app; Team/Enterprise restricted to the org unless admin enables external sharing. Sources: support.claude.com 10593882 and 16762496; fetched 2026-11-27.
